training.objective: CE + 0.1 self-generated repeated-fourgram UL every10updates + 1.0 causal repeated-fourgram completion unlikelihood within past64 completion positions on unique non-special candidates excluding the true next token; same raw targets

sequenceUnlikelihood.prefixSelection: First sampled TRAIN row, true first min32 tokens including own BOS; no heldout prefix
sequenceUnlikelihood.normalization: sum repeated generated-target penalties / all generated positions
sequenceUnlikelihood.dropoutRng: fork_rng CPU; restore global CE dropout RNG and model mode

training.initialization: Our Round11 latest model + AdamW moments + Torch/Python RNG; hold terminal learning rate
training.schedule: Hold exact Round11 terminal LR throughout additional10000; preserve moments and RNG, no restart
training.validationStatus: Previously exposed development sources; not independent unseen validation
training.batching: Conditional length buckets64/128/256; same marginal row probabilities, correlated batch lengths; no target truncation. Different update trajectory from unbucketed pilots.
training.selection: Lowest weighted development segmentation NLL/byte; test untouched

validation.metric: Weighted segmentation diagnostic; not probability of independent text
